comments.author: Monarchy
comments.body: Immediately gain a chance to use Solar Barge without doing a Secret Edict.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Note: if your inventory is full when you speak to the Well-Dressed Gentleman, this item will go to your bank 'receive item' inventory. It is also non-tradeable.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: According to a friend, this item can allow even first-time players who just opened the option to do Solar Barge IQ to skip the three edict quests and go straight to Atlantis.

wiki:
12/20/2023~1/3/2024 Before maintenance
Please go to "Well-Dressed Gentleman" standing in Tavern, you can obtain this. It will make you skip 3 quests of building Solar Barge (as long as you complete Atlantis chain up to barge unlock quests; see below.

1/3 After maintenance ~1/17/2024
You can obtain the item once again.

Quest to complete before Edict is usable:

Those Who Seek and Those Who Lead
Dangerous Caribbean
A Lord and a Merchant
